mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates disinflationary monetary policy that lowers real rates and boosts equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) during late-cycle contractions signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of late-cycle contraction periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, stimulating economic activity and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and job growth (PAYEMS) indicates dual supply-labor market shocks that cause economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when both PAYEMS and INDPRO decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during monetary tightening cycles signals higher borrowing costs that reduce corporate investment and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
